programs.title: Structured programs with
programs.text: Two programs, each with a set member discount and what partners get in return.

insurance.title: Insurance Benefits Program
insurance.text: Despite the essential role riders and drivers play in Tanzania's economy, insurance penetration remains low due to high perceived costs, complicated enrollment and a lack of tailored products. RAVU bridges this gap by giving underwriters a single organized distribution platform.
insurance.discountText: Minimum 20% discount on standard insurance premiums for all verified RAVU members.
insurance.valueAddedIntro: Where constrained by underwriting rules, equivalent value-added benefits include:
insurance.valueAddedText: Reduced deductibles/excess • Complimentary personal accident cover • Emergency roadside assistance • Flexible payment plans • Priority claims processing • Passenger & family extensions • Claim-free loyalty rewards.
insurance.productsText: Spanning individual riders, three-wheelers, member households, SMEs and commercial fleets.

maintenance.partsText: Minimum member discount on genuine motorcycle, car, truck & bus parts, tires, batteries, lubricants and filters.

responsibility.title: What each side
responsibility.partnerSubtitle: What official RAVU partners deliver to members
partnerItems: Provide preferred member discounts (20%+ insurance / up to 25% spare parts / up to 20% garage)
Supply genuine, high-quality spare parts and professional service standards
Recognize verified RAVU Member IDs across all participating branches
Maintain transparent pricing and consistent product/service availability
Deliver priority claims processing, timely service and warranty support
responsibility.ravuSubtitle: How RAVU drives volume and retention to your branches
ravuItems: Actively promote partner products and service locations across the RAVU network
Conduct member awareness campaigns, events and marketing activations
Assist with rider onboarding, policy enrollment and customer referrals
Verify member eligibility instantly via the RAVU Partner Portal
Encourage timely policy renewals, repeat workshop visits and service feedback

pilot.title: Start with the Dar es Salaam pilot
pilot.text: We recommend launching new insurance and service partnerships through a focused pilot phase in Dar es Salaam. At the conclusion of the pilot, both parties evaluate performance metrics to scale nationwide.
objectives: Measure member uptake, utilization and partner sales volume
Assess product suitability and evaluate discount effectiveness
Monitor claims experience and workshop service turnaround
Refine member onboarding and digital ID verification workflows
Establish operational best practices for national expansion
